sloka: तत्र यानि अवहीनानि तानि अहम् न उपलक्षये ।यानि अस्या न अवहीनानि तानि इमानि न सम्शयः ॥५-१५-४४॥
transliteration: tatra yāni avahīnāni tāni aham na upalakṣaye ।yāni asyā na avahīnāni tāni imāni na samśayaḥ ॥5-15-44॥

translations.english: "I think these ornaments are the same that were described by Rama. Those dropped (by Sita) are not found on her body. These were not dropped.There is no doubt."
